_comment: Config for the update_audit tool — the deterministic 'validate the result' pass for the Schematic → PCB update (KiCad's Update-PCB-from-Schematic). It parses the .kicad_sch and the sibling .kicad_pcb and asserts they agree: every symbol has a board footprint, nets survived the sync name-for-name, pads that should be connected are, and the board is UUID-linked (not just reference-matched). Read-only — it never edits either file, keeping 'apply the update' separate from 'verify the result'. Cached; RESTART the backend after edits. Verdict in words per feedback_no_percentage_scores.

component_presence._rule: Rules 4/5 — every schematic symbol must have a footprint on the board and vice-versa. A symbol with no board footprint = not synced (often an unresolved footprint upstream); a board footprint with no symbol = an orphan the next sync would delete.

unresolved_footprint._rule: Rule 5 — a schematic symbol with an empty Footprint field can never sync to the board; the fix is upstream (assign the footprint, see footprint_audit), then re-run update, never a manual drop on the board.

net_survival._rule: Rule 8 — every named net in the schematic/IR must appear in the board net table. A missing name, or an auto-named Net-(Rx-Pady) where a name was expected, signals a lost label or power flag.

unconnected_pads._rule: Rule 7 — a pad the IR says belongs to a real net must not sit on board net 0 (unconnected). Proxy for the ratsnest check without pcbnew: compares the IR pin→net map against the board's per-pad net assignments.

uuid_linkage._rule: Rule 3 — footprints should carry the schematic symbol's UUID (path), so renumbering never triggers delete-and-recreate. A board generated from scratch (no path links) is reference-matched only; a native Update-from-Schematic restores stable UUID links.

skip_ref_prefixes._comment: Virtual refs (power ports, PWR_FLAG) that never become board footprints.

verdict.clean: SYNC VERIFIED — schematic and board agree ({n} parts, {nets} nets)
verdict.issues: SYNC NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {w} warning(s) between schematic and board
verdict.no_board: NO BOARD — no .kicad_pcb next to this schematic; run generate/update PCB first
verdict.empty_sch: NO PARTS — schematic has no components to sync
